requests.summary: Duel Flip's free panel scores are done (10 tables, 1,600 games per persona). Predicted fun: casual 4.05, competitor 4.02, strategist 3.85, family 3.62, story 3.56. Next step is five in-character AI reviews (Haiku, one per persona).
requests.why_needed: The scores are numbers only. The reviews add the 'why': best and worst moments, real frustrations, who each persona enjoyed playing with. Task 006 asks for them as the first full test of the panel.
requests.expected_outcome: Five review files in games/duelflip/panel/, a panel-report.md, and reviews that read like five different people, each naming a real frustration.
